record.question: Attending to ward routines such as medical record documentation, stocking and replenishing drug supplies is the job responsibilities of:
record.explanation: Answer C: Ward Clerk. Ward clerks commonly support ward routines such as documentation flow and replenishing supplies; nurses remain responsible for nursing care and medication administration. Source/context note: Duties vary by institution; inventory and documentation responsibilities may be shared. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK470379/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
